name: sarah-coaching-bot
description: Deliberate practice and feedback for executive-coaching conversations.

interface.longDescription: Sarah presents fictional executive-coaching moments, simulates a plausible client response, and gives formative feedback using a Foursquare coaching lens, ICF-aligned behaviors, and a transparent five-part rubric.
defaultPrompt: Give me a fictional coaching scenario to practice.
Critique this coaching response using Sarah's rubric.
Help me practice Support for Thought.
